T: The saga ends. The snacks don't.
D: Rey and her friends race to find the hidden world where the Emperor has returned.
P: Serve the snacks during the festival on Pasaana.
S: the colourful Festival of the Ancestors on Pasaana
Flatbreads brushed with oil and dusted with sumac, paprika and turmeric, grilled and served with three dips: hummus, beetroot and green herb yoghurt.
Chicken and ginger dumplings steamed 10 minutes, served in a little hot broth with spring onion and chilli oil.
Mini toasts topped with mushroom pâté, a slice of cornichon and a pinch of thyme, small enough for Babu Frik.
M: the stormy ocean and the old Death Star wreck
Fish, prawns and mussels simmered in a tomato, fennel and white wine broth with saffron, served with garlic toast.
the whole fleet arriving over Exegol
Rib eye seared hard, butter basted, rested and sliced over buttery mash with a peppercorn sauce.
W: Rey on Tatooine at the very end
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with cream, mango and passionfruit for two glowing suns.
K: Rey burying the lightsabers at the old homestead
Milk blended with coconut milk, honey and a few drops of blue colouring, served cold.

s.note: the colourful Festival of the Ancestors on Pasaana
s.how: Brush flatbreads with olive oil and dust with sumac and a little turmeric, then grill until blistered. Blend roasted beetroot with garlic and a spoon of yoghurt for a pink dip, and stir herbs through more yoghurt for a green dip. Serve with hummus.

Mix 400g chicken mince with grated ginger, sliced spring onion and soy. Fill dumpling wrappers, pleat closed and steam for 10 minutes. Serve a few in each bowl with a ladle of hot chicken stock, more spring onion and a drizzle of chilli oil.

m.note: the stormy ocean and the old Death Star wreck
m.how: Soften sliced fennel and garlic in olive oil, add a pinch of saffron, a can of crushed tomatoes and a cup of white wine and simmer 20 minutes. Add 400g white fish chunks, 300g green prawns and 500g mussels, cover and cook 6 minutes. Serve with garlic toast.

w.note: Rey on Tatooine at the very end
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream, sliced mango and two round pools of passionfruit pulp.

d.note: Rey burying the lightsabers at the old homestead
d.how: Blend 750ml cold milk with 250ml coconut milk, 2 tbsp honey and a handful of ice until frothy. Add a few drops of blue food colouring and blend again until evenly pale blue. Pour into glasses and serve cold, the way the moisture farm does.
